name: 40 Hz sine, right parietotemporal, 30 min (Sculthorpe 2003)
origin: Sculthorpe & Persinger (Laurentian University), 2003 phase-modulation and hypnotic-induction study, 40 Hz arm
summary: One of four arms of Sculthorpe & Persinger (2003): a plain 40 Hz sine at 1 uT over the right parietotemporal region for 30 min. The paper reports that this group rated the session more pleasant than the 5 Hz group (1.8 against 0.5), but not more than sham (1.2).
notes: 24 people, three men and three women per arm, got a sham, a 5 Hz sine, a 40 Hz sine or a phase-modulated 40 Hz field for 30 min between two Spiegel Hypnotic Induction Profiles. 'In the experiment all point durations were 3 msec' (Sculthorpe 2003 p.3 [1033]). This program plays a 40 Hz sine in 3-ms steps for 30 min. The paper does not say how a 40 Hz sine was built from 3-ms points (8 points give 41.7 Hz). Coils: the paper says only 'applied over the right parietotemporal region through a modified helmet', to copy the geometry of the lab's earlier suggestibility studies (p.1 [1031]). There the helmet drove one left-right pair at a time and the other side got about a tenth (Healey 1996 p.3 [203]); this paper says neither. Three right-side coils at T8, TP8 and P8 playing together, with the left side silent, are this project's choice. Field: 1 uT; where it was measured is not stated. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. Result: pleasantness means were sham 1.2, 5 Hz 0.5, 40 Hz 1.8 and phase-modulated 40 Hz 0.8 (Table 1, p.5 [1035]). The 40 Hz group differed from the 5 Hz group, not from sham. The study's hypothesis, that phase modulation explains the lab's earlier suggestibility gains, was not supported. Six people per arm, one lab, not repeated elsewhere. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Use the app's Blind option for the sham arm. Not for people with epilepsy or a seizure history, implanted devices or pregnancy; stop on distress.
setting: Seated in a quiet room with the eyes closed or covered; in the original, the Spiegel Hypnotic Induction Profile was given before and after the 30 min.
schedule: One session per person in the original (between-subjects, six per arm). For a self-test, compare the arms and sham in blinded, counterbalanced order on separate days.
source: Sculthorpe & Persinger 2003, Does phase-modulation of applied 40-Hz transcerebral magnetic fields affect subjective experiences and hypnotic induction?, Percept Mot Skills 97:1031-1037 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15002842/ ; Healey, Persinger & Koren 1996, Int J Neurosci 87:201-207 (the earlier right-temporoparietal suggestibility effect) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/9003980/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
